facts.text: SofaGym registers 'trunk-v0' with entry point 'sofagym.envs:TrunkEnv'

TrunkEnv.DEFAULT_CONFIG sets scene Trunk, deterministic True, goal True, the goalList positions [40, 40, 100] and [-10, 20, 80], scale_factor 5, timer_limit 250, discrete True, dt 0.01, nb_actions 16, dim_state 66 and randomize_states False
TrunkEnv sets the wrapped environment's action_space to spaces.Discrete(nb_actions)
TrunkEnv sets the wrapped environment's observation_space to a Box with low -1 and high 1 and dim_state elements
TrunkEnv constructs an AbstractEnv (or a ServerEnv when use_server is set) and keeps it in self.env
TrunkEnv defines __getattr__ and forwards any missing attribute to its wrapped environment
TrunkEnv.reset calls initialize_states, init_goal and the wrapped environment's reset, then returns the state array
AbstractEnv.step returns the legacy four-tuple obs, reward, done, info
AbstractEnv.step calls step_simulation once per environment step
step_simulation applies the action and then runs scale_factor simulation steps of dt seconds each
The default trunk configuration sets scale_factor 5 and dt 0.01 s, so one environment step advances 0.05 s of simulated time
action_to_command maps actions 0-7 to cables 0-7 with displacement +1 and actions 8-15 to cables 0-7 with displacement -1, and raises NotImplementedError for any other action
The trunk prefab is documented as actuated with 8 cables

The trunk scene creates four large cables and four small cables in self.cables; each large cable has 21 positions (a pull point plus the 20 points of the loop) and each small one 11 (a pull point plus 10)
getState reads the point count of the first cable, averages those points over the first four cables, rounds every coordinate to 3 decimals and divides it by 4, then appends the goal position
The tip used by the reward is the mean of the last points of the first four cables
The reward is min(sqrt(max((previous distance - current distance) / previous distance, 0)), 1.0) and the cost is the current tip-to-goal distance
getReward returns done True when the tip-to-goal distance is at most 1.0 and False otherwise
A reset draws a new goal from goalList with np_random.choice
seed() replaces np_random with seeding.np_random(seed)
AbstractEnv initializes np_random from config['seed'] in __init__
AbstractEnv.step increments timer and sets a local truncated flag at timer_limit but returns the four-tuple without it, so the flag is discarded
The cable constraints set maxPositiveDisp 70 for the large cables and 40 for the small cables, with maxDispVariation 1
The trunk length is 195 and the four pull points sit at distance 10 from the axis
TrunkEnv declares dim_state 66
SofaGym needs a SOFA installation, currently supported version v23.06, with the mandatory SofaPython3 plugin and SoftRobots among the optional plugins
The README states SofaGym works with gym v0.21.0
The documented loop is gym.make('trunk-v0'), env.seed(42), env.reset(), then env.step(action) returning observation, reward, done and info, and env.close()

determinism.notes: the goal is drawn from goalList with the environment's np_random, seeded by seed() or by the legacy reset(seed) fallback of the bridge, and the cable model is deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; this package's fake draws with Python's random.Random and upstream with gym's numpy generator, so one seed can give a different goal and trajectory on the two

gaps: SOFA TetrahedronFEM deformation of a soft trunk with eight cable constraints is replaced by a placeholder kinematic bend (a lateral offset proportional to the cable displacement), so trajectories do not match the clone's finite-element solve

the scene's own cable geometry (length 195, 21 points, four radial families) is rebuilt from TrunkScene.py:72-95, but the four small cables do not change the state the clone reads (getState uses cables[:4]) and are folded into the shared bend by this fake
the goal is drawn with Python's random.Random; upstream draws it with gym.utils.seeding.np_random, so the same seed can select a different goal

the clone's step returns a four-tuple and discards the timer_limit truncation it computes (AbstractEnv.py:359-367); the fake does the same, so a long episode is never truncated or terminated by the timer
the declared observation_space Box(-1, 1, 66) does not bound the coordinates getState returns; neither the bridge nor the fake clamps observations
no rendering, viewer, camera or image output is modelled
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, ticks advance simulated time by timestep_ms only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
